raw_text: Lakshmi the cow enjoying the morning sun in the pasture. She just had her calf last week!
Fresh paneer made this morning from our own cows milk. Lunch prasadam prep in full swing.
Morning mangal arati — the deities are decorated with fresh flowers from our garden.
Spring planting season begins! Our team is preparing 2 acres of organic vegetable beds.
Weekend volunteer day — 15 families came to help with the new greenhouse build.
Join us for Sunday Feast this week! Farm-to-table vegetarian prasadam. All welcome.
Our oxen Rama and Krishna pulling the plow for the first time this season. Traditional farming at its finest.
Gaura Purnima festival preparations — the temple is alive with devotion and celebration.
